title: EmergencyResponse
description: The decision an emergency service made about an incident, and the constraints it places on everyone else. Kept as its own record rather than as a flag on the incident, because it is written by a party outside the commercial chain and has to stay attributable to it. clearanceDeadlineAt is read by the recovery matching as a hard requirement, and releasedForRecoveryAt is what a recovery may not lawfully start before in a crash. Held in the vehicle eVault so it sits with the rest of the case, under an access grant bound to the dispatch purpose and expiring with it.

incidentEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the Incident the service responded to

serviceType.description: Kind of emergency service. roadAuthorityIncidentResponse is the road authority's own response to an incident on its roads.

respondingOfficerEName.description: The named responder, where the service is willing to attribute at that level

receivedAt.description: When the service was told about the incident

dispatchDecision.description: Published so every other party sees it without asking

onSceneAt.description: When the service arrived at the scene

roadBlocked.description: Whether the incident blocks the road for traffic

lanesClosed.description: Number of lanes closed to traffic because of the incident

vehicleMayBeMoved.description: False until the scene is released. Recovery cannot lawfully start before this in a crash.

releasedForRecoveryAt.description: When the scene was released and vehicleMayBeMoved became true

trafficMeasures.description: What the road authority has put in place around the scene, so the recovery knows what it drives into and everyone knows the road is being managed

roadClearedAt.description: When the road was free again and the measures were lifted: the end of the incident for traffic, which may come well before the end of the case

clearanceDeadlineAt.description: Set or relayed for the road section. The recovery matching treats it as a hard requirement, not a target.

hazards.description: What changes the response: drivetrain, fire, fluid spill, hazardous load, trapped occupants

roadAuthorityNotifiedEName.description: Road authority notified for the affected section, where the road authority participates rather than only supplying rules. Absent on the road authority's own response, whose serviceEName already names it.

onSceneReportRef.description: Pointer to the on-scene report held by the service, not the report itself. What may be shared into the case, and with whom, still needs legal input.

accessGrantEnvelopeId.description: The grant under which the service read the case. Emergency access is broad but logged, rather than unlimited and silent.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
